candidates.prompt_suffix: The host-supplied fact_ledger is the closed list of allowed clinical facts. Create claims for its facts and no others. Never create claims merely to fill sections. Copy each ledger row's source_ids exactly onto claims derived from that row. Split a ledger statement into separate claims when it joins a symptom and an explicit negative with a semicolon. Exception: keep a row whose category is Medication conflict as one conflict claim containing both sides and all its source_ids. Omit sections with no ledger-derived claims. Coverage is not clinical content: list each source once, mark it cited exactly when a claim cites it, otherwise reviewed_not_cited or excluded.

Use fact_ledger as a closed whitelist. Preserve its wording with only minimal readability edits; do not derive any additional clinical claim from sources. Every claim must use exactly the source_ids from its ledger row. For a semicolon joining a symptom to an explicit negative, make two claims. For a Medication conflict row, make one claim containing both sides and all listed source_ids. Do not fill empty sections and never claim that information is missing, absent, unavailable, unknown, or undocumented. Account for each source exactly once in coverage after making the claims.
